disposition_reason: Three red chilli cultivars grown on one farm analysed for six metals by flame AAS.

study.origin: farm at Wadh, district Khuzdar, Pakistan
study.period_text: sown June 2016, ripe fruit collected September 2016
study.method: HNO3/H2O2 hot-plate digestion and flame AAS (PE AAnalyst 700) after oven-drying at 150 C
study.qa: triplicates; no CRM or recovery reported

findings.material_label: Red chilli, dried (Capsicum annuum), cultivar Dandi
findings.group: cultivar Dandi, farm at Wadh, Khuzdar
findings.notes: Mean ± SEM of three replicates (SEM 0.0019 ppm). Dried chillies oven-dried at 150 C before digestion; basis not labelled.
